title: Custom Craft Systems
body:
# Custom config-driven system for creating unlockable recipes

Have you ever wanted to lock certain crafts behind grinding wall or add crafting progression? 
Then this plugin is made for you!

## (Comes with default config)

### You can:
- Create different branches with different unlocking conditions and requirements
- Adjust amount of exp given by certain crafts
- Block certain items from crafting entirely
- All of it is done by config file!
- And much, much more!
